changelog.en:
New: three new wallpapers — Cosmic Flow (Sony's flowing swirls, 8 colour themes), Shake Them All (falling Androids on a physics simulation) and Flowing Silk (flowing ribbons, 3 colour themes)
New: Fireworks — particle count, burst trails and an enhanced comet mode
New: rainbow colour mode on Nexus, and an adjustable microbe count with per-size colouring
New: touch rotation on Cube, manual theme selection on Aurora 2, idle mode on the music visualisations
New: inline colour picker in wallpaper settings, and a feedback tile in the wallpaper list

Fixed: switching wallpapers could leave the previous wallpaper's last frame on screen
Fixed: the picture could stretch and clip at one edge after the canvas changed size
Fixed: several Grass issues — the draw order of weather and the night sky, the night tone, the moon's tilt, and the wind phase
Fixed: settings could show stale values after a toggle, a reset or a dependency change
Fixed: a number of paths that only failed once something else had already gone wrong

Changed: wallpaper names and translations aligned with the originals
Changed: all wallpaper icons unified to 512x512
Changed: Water Leaves' backdrop and visuals reworked for better image quality
Changed: smoother animation and lower memory use across several wallpapers
changelog.zh:
新增：三个新壁纸——宇宙流动（索尼的流动波纹，8 种主题配色）、坠落的安卓机器人（带物理模拟的下落机器人）、丝语流年（流动丝带，3 种主题配色）
新增：烟火壁纸——粒子数量、拖尾、增强彗星模式
新增：交错光幕彩虹配色；微生物数量可调，并按体型区分颜色
新增：立方体触摸旋转、北极光2 手动主题、音乐可视化空闲模式
新增：设置页内嵌取色器；壁纸列表数量为奇数时补一个反馈入口

修复：切换壁纸偶发停留在上一张壁纸的画面
修复：画面在尺寸变化后偶发被拉伸、在边缘被截断
修复：天空草地壁纸——天气与夜空的绘制次序、夜间色调、月亮倾角、风相位
修复：设置项在开关、恢复默认或依赖变化后显示旧值
修复：若干"只在已经出错时才会失败"的路径

变更：壁纸名称与多语言翻译对齐原版
变更：全部壁纸图标统一为 512×512
变更：水面落叶壁纸背景图片与视觉效果优化
变更：多个壁纸的流畅度与内存占用优化
